messages:
carla: Kicking off RC creation for release candidate `v2.6.0-rc3`. Need final signoffs to queue the deploybot. Checklist: QA smoke + e2e, KV warm, artifact pinned, release notes updated, migration flag set, rollback playbook approved. Deploy window 16:00-18:00 PT (quiet window).
ben: QA smoke is green on staging. e2e has one flaky failure in `payments.test::refund_flow` — re-run now, ETA ~25m.
alice: I reviewed the rollback playbook and it's fine. I posted DB migration steps in Confluence. Artifact to pin: `registry.redwood/api:v2.6.0-rc3` — confirm and I'll tag.
dan: Pinning artifact now in CI: tag `v2.6.0-rc3` pushed, manifest pinned. I'll add a short note about the schema migration to the release notes.
deploy-bot: NOTE: promotion requests require these exact flags: `/deploy promote --env=prod --artifact=ARTIFACT --canary=2% --stages=3 --pin=true`. Use the ops channel for the actual command.
carla: erin — can you schedule KV warm and a short rollout smoke at 16:10 PT? Put shard 3 first, then 1/2.
erin: KV warm scheduled at 16:10 PT. Warm script ran on shard-3 in staging; results look stable. I'll warm prod shards in order once canary starts.
ben: flaky test fixed, re-run passed. QA final: :thumbsup: All checks green.
alice: Release notes updated with migration steps, fallback toggles, and feature-flag keys. Small docs diff: https://confluence.redwood/release/v2.6.0-rc3 (linked).
dan: DB migration flag `db.migrate.v2_6` set to `off` by default, ops will flip during rollout if metrics stay green.
carla: OK — ready to queue deploybot when someone posts the command in ops. Reminder: deadman timer 20m and auto-rollback threshold: error rate > 0.5% or p95 latency +30% over baseline for more than 5m.
alice: I'm in ops to run it. Command I'll use: `/deploy promote --env=prod --artifact=registry.redwood/api:v2.6.0-rc3 --canary=2% --stages=3 --pin=true`
deploy-bot: Promotion initiated. Stage 1 (2% canary) started. Health checks: latency p95 < 150ms, error < 0.5%.
deploy-bot: Stage 1 healthy after 4m. Proceeding to stage 2 (25%).
erin: Monitoring dashboards — small spike in token CPU on one canary host, but overall latency stable. Watching.
dan: Starting a controlled DB migration toggle on 10% of traffic as an internal experiment (behind flag) — will not affect majority.
carla: Great, keep an eye on traces for any route error budgets. If anything, call rollback.
deploy-bot: Stage 2 healthy. Progressing to 100% rollout in 10m increments.
alice: Rolling release notes published and release tag `v2.6.0-rc3` created in the repo.
erin: KV warms completed for all prod shards. Warm metrics look good.
carla: Final: promoting to 100%. If regressions exceed thresholds, rollback command: `deploybot rollback --to=registry.redwood/api:v2.6.0-rc2` (manual).
deploy-bot: Rollout complete — 100% traffic on `registry.redwood/api:v2.6.0-rc3`. No automatic rollback triggered.
ben: Quick post-deploy smoke looks good. No error spikes.
dan: Migration flag flipped to `on` for all traffic slowly over 15m. Observability shows normal behavior.
carla: Closing RC thread. I'll ship the release notes to stakeholders and update the release tracker. Thanks everyone :party-deploy:
